directory_policies.notes.8: English policy: Standard TOEFL 92/120 or 5/6, IELTS 7, DET 125. Lower in-person ranges require program approval and ESLAT, so they remain unknown. Fall 2027 planning uses a September 3, 2025 earliest test date, derived from strict two-year validity at the published September 2, 2027 instruction start.

fact_summary: Standard English thresholds and lower conditional ranges require distinct decisions; test validity is strictly less than two years from the first day of the enrollment term.
